invariants: GitHub Issues and pull requests are the live status authority; this manifest is a dependency and dispatch contract, not a status snapshot.
Create a fresh task contract with the current immutable base SHA before every implementation.
Use one task, one branch, and one isolated worktree; never modify or clean another contributor's checkout.
Planner, implementer, verifier, correctness reviewer, and GPU reviewer roles remain separate as required by risk class.
Humans own merges, review-thread resolution, waivers, visual/product semantics, baseline changes, releases, and support declarations.
Never weaken a guard, threshold, baseline, or gate to make evidence green.
At most two heavy builds, GPU runs, full suites, or large transformations may run concurrently across the program.

Work only in isolated task worktrees from freshly queried immutable bases. Stop at merge-ready evidence and queued human decisions; never merge, resolve review threads, waive failures, or re-pin a baseline without written owner approval.

milestones.title: Make green mean tested
milestones.objective: Make GodotGS green mean tested by closing the fail-open runtime, production-default visual, GPU-batch reachability, fixture-authority, and performance-baseline gaps with mutation-proven guards. Work from freshly queried immutable bases, keep deterministic and GPU lanes separate, and never weaken a gate or declare unavailable hardware passed. Prepare stable protection settings for human activation only after the candidate lanes have an evidenced soak.

milestones.title: Eliminate data and runtime correctness hazards
milestones.objective: Eliminate the investigated user-facing data and runtime correctness hazards in GodotGS: world-resource payload changes must resubmit, scene serialization must obey the established data lock, incremental deltas must verify baseline identity rather than count alone, and sorter failure must never silently render unsorted translucent output. Deliver each repair as a separate risk-classified task with failure-path and concurrency evidence, stopping at human disposition for format/API choices and merges.

work_items.purpose: Resubmit changed world-resource payloads without lifetime or resubmission storms.
Protect serializer reads with the established Gaussian data lock.
Version and verify incremental baseline content identity, not only splat count.
Remove silent unsorted translucent rendering on sort failure.

agent_completion_criteria: Every issue has a minimal reproducer that fails on its dispatch base.
Corrections pass targeted, guard, concurrency, persistence, and runtime/GPU evidence required by their risk class.
Failure and teardown paths remain bounded and leak-free.
Format or API changes have approved design records and backward-compatibility evidence.
human_gates: Incremental format/version and migration decisions.
User-visible degraded/error behavior for unavailable sorting.
All R3 design approvals, waivers, and merges.

milestones.title: Complete renderer parity and recovery
milestones.objective: Complete renderer recovery and compositor parity without changing the settled pre-upscale contract: sorter initialization must recover from every supported transient exit, transparent backgrounds must preserve splat-edge alpha, temporal consumers must receive correctly aligned splat projection, painterly compositing must obey the color-space contract, and Forward Mobile must either gain evidenced parity or be explicitly unsupported. Use real-scan GPU evidence and independent GPU review for every visual or synchronization change; stop for human visual and architecture decisions.

Approve Forward Mobile parity or an explicit unsupported contract before implementation.

milestones.title: Prepare a defensible public-alpha candidate
milestones.objective: Prepare a defensible GodotGS public-alpha candidate whose claims match executed evidence: define the release bar and accepted limitations, verify supported-platform compatibility, produce real screenshots and workflow clips from the exact candidate, and assemble reproducible editor/export/runtime/GPU evidence. Do not publish a stable release or broaden support claims autonomously; stop with a hash-bound candidate and a complete human release-decision packet.

milestones.title: Re-baseline onto supported Godot versions
milestones.objective: Prepare GodotGS on the latest approved supported Godot baseline through two controlled content re-baselines, current-to-4.6.3 and 4.6.3-to-4.7.2, with mechanical upstream adoption separated from GodotGS engine-hook ports. Freeze every base and upstream tag, account for every engine integration file, preserve asset/project compatibility, and qualify each hop with builds, guards, runtime, GPU, real-scan, import/open, and export evidence. Never merge a hop, target 4.8 development, or choose a compatibility break without human approval.
